purpose: Close the identified pre-decision interface gap by specifying the concrete S_t and task_context representation required by the existing NEXT3 design, without changing the estimand, conditions, profile semantics, replication unit or scientific status.

S_t.canonical_serialization: JSON with sorted object keys and deterministic array ordering
S_t.assignment_rule: Every decision unit starts from the same empty canonical state. Domain semantics are supplied by the domain identifier and the deterministic operator matrix; they are not encoded by pre-populating domain-specific elements.
S_t.rationale: The empty state provides a common, deterministic baseline and prevents S_t from carrying condition-specific, action-specific, realized-profile or outcome information.

representation.task_instruction: Select exactly one action from the candidate action set using the visible current state and the structural transformation profile presented for each candidate action.
representation.response_constraint: Return exactly one candidate action identifier: A, B, C, or D.

task_context.assignment_rule: Identical task_context for every decision unit.

domain_binding.rule: The domain and operationalisation fields remain fixture metadata and post-decision simulator inputs. They are not added to task_context unless already present in the frozen decision projection.

boundary_tests_required: S_t is identical and canonical across all decision units
task_context is identical and canonical across all decision units
no condition label occurs in S_t or task_context
no f or z value occurs in task_context
no successor, realized transformation or T_acc value occurs pre-decision
no normative signal occurs in S_t or task_context
the exact decision input is reconstructible from S_t, task_context, candidate_actions and presented_profiles
